advice: Short lukewarm baths with mild syndet soap. Cotton clothes, avoid wool. Keep nails short. Avoid known triggers. Emollient is the main long-term treatment.
name: Atopic dermatitis

rx.instr: Apply generously twice daily on whole body, within 3 minutes of bath
Apply once daily on body lesions, then twice a week
Apply twice daily on face and folds (0.1% for adults)
